capabilities: Add spaces between Chinese text and English letters or numbers
Protect code blocks, inline code, math, tags, and link destinations during formatting
Optionally apply full Markdown formatting with configurable indentation
Space text automatically as you type, waiting for IME composition to finish
Localize commands and settings in English or Simplified Chinese
extras: Desktop only and requires Obsidian 1.0.3 or later; automatic as-you-type spacing skips notes longer than 10,000 UTF-16 code units, though they can still be formatted manually.
problem: Obsidian does not automatically insert spacing at Chinese/English/number boundaries, so writers mixing scripts must add those spaces by hand.

summary: Formatting plugin that adds spaces between Chinese text and English letters or numbers while preserving code, math, tags, and Markdown structure.
